_readme: WHAT THIS IS FOR, and why the 52-question set could not do it.
eval_questions_ko.json asks every one of its 52 questions in the CORPUS'S OWN
vocabulary - it was written by reading the manual, so a question about
공지예외주장 uses the word 공지예외주장. That makes it structurally blind to the
failure this set exists to measure: a person types 어플, and the examination
standards print 애플리케이션 소프트웨어, 컴퓨터 프로그램 and 응용 소프트웨어 and
never once print 어플 or 앱. No tokenizer bridges that. Worse than absent:
under the character-bigram sparse arm 어플 MATCHES 휴대용멀티미디어플레이어 and
전기식메이크업어플리케이터, so the colloquial word actively drags retrieval
toward the wrong goods.
So every question here is phrased the way somebody starting a business types
it - 어플, 치킨집, 학원, 강아지 사료, 동네 마트 - and every one is answerable
from this corpus, by a section that uses none of those words.
THE ANCHORS ARE DELIBERATELY STRICT, and chosen so BEFORE and AFTER are
comparable. Each is a line of the section's 상품의 범위 / 서비스업의 범위 - the
sentence that actually answers 'which class, which goods' - and each occurs in
EXACTLY ONE chunk, under both the old chunking and the classification-table
one. Deliberately NOT the '[제9류/G390802]' marker line: the re-chunk repeats
that marker on every chunk of its section, so scoring against it would credit
the change with hits it did not earn.
gold_pages are keyed per question to the document that answers it, because the
answers live in two documents. c02 is the only one whose answer is in
상표심사기준; the rest are 유사상품 심사기준.
Run:  python scripts/eval_retrieval.py --fixture scripts/eval_questions_ko_colloquial.json

questions.question: 어플 하나 만들어서 이름을 상표로 등록하려고 하는데, 몇 류로 내야 하고 지정상품은 뭐라고 적어야 하나요?

치킨집 차리는데 가게 이름을 상표로 등록하려면 어느 류로 내야 하나요?
동네에서 애들 가르치는 학원 이름을 상표로 내고 싶은데 무슨 류인가요?
강아지 사료 브랜드를 만들었는데 상표 낼 때 상품류가 어떻게 되나요?
원두 볶아서 파는데 커피 브랜드 이름 상표는 몇 류로 등록하나요?
동네 마트 이름을 상표로 등록하려는데 어떤 류에 넣어야 하나요?
티셔츠랑 니트 만들어 파는 옷 브랜드인데 상표 낼 때 지정상품을 뭐로 쓰나요?
